description: Metadata of a CNAE-2009 code: description, level, parent and number of companies. Works for section letters and two-digit divisions; longer codes may answer 404. Use it to confirm what a `cnae_code` from a company search means.

code.description: CNAE-2009 code: a section letter (e.g. "J"), a 2-digit division (e.g. "62") or a longer numeric code.

name: borme_get_cnae
